cases.title: A clean invoice
cases.story: Every field quoted from the page, totals computed, KoSIT accepts it.

cases.title: Seven line items
cases.story: Seven line items. Nemotron Ultra repairs three fields behind the patch guard; every amount is computed from the lines.

cases.title: Unusual layout
cases.story: Plain number format, ISO dates and shuffled blocks still end in a valid e-invoice.

cases.title: Units printed as words
cases.story: "Stück" is not a unit code. KoSIT reports it as an error yet still accepts the invoice; Verdict normalizes it to H87.

cases.title: Printed total is wrong
cases.story: The document adds up to 1.00 less than it claims. Verdict trusts the lines, computes the total and flags the difference.

cases.title: Leitweg-ID missing
cases.story: The buyer reference is not printed. Verdict asks for it instead of inventing one.

cases.title: Bank details missing
cases.story: Payment by transfer, but no IBAN on the page. Verdict stops and asks.
